title: Is ElevenLabs Scribe v2 Realtime a Fit for Your Live Transcription Build?
markdown:
If you are evaluating speech-to-text before committing to an implementation, the useful question is not simply whether a service transcribes audio. It is whether its realtime capabilities match the way your product receives, processes, and finalizes live speech.

ElevenLabs presents Scribe v2 Realtime as an API-available realtime transcription model for live speech, with stated latency of about 150 ms and support for 90+ languages. Its listed use cases include conversational agents, meetings, and voice applications. [ElevenLabs Realtime Speech to Text](https://elevenlabs.io/realtime-speech-to-text)

For an integration review, inspect the audio and streaming constraints first. The product page says it supports PCM from 8–48 kHz and μ-law encoding, supports continuous audio chunks, and offers WebSocket or REST API integration. It also describes voice activity detection and manual commit control, which may matter when your application needs to decide when a transcript is final. [ElevenLabs Realtime Speech to Text](https://elevenlabs.io/realtime-speech-to-text)

Language and workflow requirements deserve the same scrutiny. ElevenLabs says the model handles accents, dialects, and varied acoustic conditions, and mentions complex vocabulary such as technical language, medications, and proper nouns. Those are product descriptions, so validate them with audio representative of your users and environment before making a production decision. [ElevenLabs Realtime Speech to Text](https://elevenlabs.io/realtime-speech-to-text)

There are also stated limitations to account for: the FAQ says realtime speaker diarization is not a current priority and dual-channel support is not planned. If either is essential to your call or meeting workflow, confirm an alternative design before proceeding. [ElevenLabs Realtime Speech to Text](https://elevenlabs.io/realtime-speech-to-text)

Cost planning should include the shared-credit model. ElevenLabs lists Speech to Text at approximately 330 credits per minute, while its product page advertises "$0.28 per hour & lower" on annual Business plans; pricing pages also note that taxes, levies, and duties are excluded. Check the current plan and usage details for your account before purchase. [ElevenLabs Pricing](https://elevenlabs.io/pricing) [ElevenLabs Realtime Speech to Text](https://elevenlabs.io/realtime-speech-to-text)
